major_concerns: Emulator fidelity vs real hardware not specified — threatens external validity.
Deterministic validators not fully specified; risk of false-safety claims if validators incomplete.
Prompts, exact model identifiers, and repair heuristics are underspecified (hurts reproducibility).
Estimated compute neglects emulation CPU/time and end-to-end latency costs.
required_design_repairs: Specify exact LLM(s) with model IDs, prompt templates, and fixed random seeds.
Provide full validator specifications (formal properties checked, code/SMT/specs) and failure coverage analysis.
Publish emulator images/configs (router images, topology scripts), and justify emulator choice against hardware.
Preregister repair algorithm details (max iterations, repair rules), latency measurement method, and a power analysis/sample-size justification.

major_concerns: Canary detection thresholds and rollback criteria are underspecified — results sensitive to tuning.
Replay/testbed scenario realism and provenance of scenario corpus unclear.
Definition of 'outage' and severity metrics needs formalization.
Potential for overfitting thresholds to synthetic scenarios.
required_design_repairs: Freeze and document canonical canary protocol: precise change scope, instrumentation, detection algorithms, thresholds, and rollback implementation.
Provide origin and construction method for the 200 scenarios; include representative distribution and seed list.
Define explicit outage/severity metrics and monitoring window parameters; preregister sensitivity analyses over thresholds.
Deliver testbed configs, telemetry collectors, and reproducible scripts to run canary+rollback experiments.

major_concerns: Gold-labeling of subtle 'no-issue' hallucinations is difficult and may be noisy without strict rubric.
Retrieval/index corpus and telemetry availability not specified — judge effectiveness depends on sources.
Risk of classifier overfitting to dataset artifacts; generalization unclear.
required_design_repairs: Provide annotation protocol, annotator qualifications, inter-annotator agreement targets, and adjudication rules for the 600-item dataset.
Specify retrieval corpus (sources, snapshot dates), embedding/retrieval models, similarity metrics, and deterministic indexing parameters.
Detail validator checks (syntactic + semantic) and telemetry cross-check procedures; preregister ablation plan and evaluation splits.
Supply rule-based baseline, classifier architecture, hyperparameters, and seeds; publish dataset and code for reproducibility.

major_concerns: Simulated operator workload model and cost function are underdefined and drive results.
Policy-grid combinatorics may exceed budget; unclear pruning strategy.
Representativeness of 400 simulated runs for real operator behavior is uncertain.
required_design_repairs: Define operator-service model precisely (response-time distribution, handling-time per escalation) and justify parameters with citations or expert elicitation.
Preregister policy-grid parameters and rationale; limit combinations with justified sampling strategy (e.g., factorial with constraints).
Specify emulator/test scenarios, seeds, and how operator actions are simulated; include sensitivity analyses for operator-model assumptions.
Provide formal cost function and outage-penalty choices and publish code to reproduce Pareto frontier computations.

major_concerns: Compute and infrastructure requirements (iterative finetuning/retraining) likely exceed stated resources (no GPUs locally).
Proxy-model dynamics may not reflect large-model retraining — threatens external validity and causal claims.
Synthetic corpus and generation regimes may introduce artifacts; mitigation strategies need rigorous specification.
required_design_repairs: Re-scope to feasible experiments given compute limits (e.g., fewer cycles, smaller models) and explicitly state limitations on generalizability.
Specify exact training procedure, hyperparameters, model architecture, dataset creation scripts, and hardware/time cost estimates; ensure within budget or request additional resources.
Formalize provenance/weighting mitigation details (how labels/weights applied) and preregister evaluation benchmarks and statistical tests.
Include simulation-only analytic baselines or theoretical bounds if full retraining is infeasible; clearly frame claims as proxy/simulation results.
